## Professional Summary
David Sawe is a top Senior Full Stack Developer and Design Engineer based in Lagos, Nigeria. He brings deep technical experience across full-stack engineering, interface architecture, payment systems, and AI/LLM solutions. Proven track record architecting and deploying end-to-end B2B platforms, SaaS products, and distributed web applications with Next.js, TypeScript, and Supabase. Adept at translating complex commercial requirements into resilient technical blueprints, data schemas, and clean, modular systems under 150 lines per module. Strong background leading cross-functional teams, driving product delivery from concept to production, and maintaining rigorous security and design standards.
